description:
Read-only price quote. Does not advance the session, open approvals or enable payment. To pay, call preview_checkout.

Computes the same totals as preview_checkout for this cart (subtotal, shipping, discount, tax status, total_is_final), with status QUOTE_ONLY, but not the same checks: it does not check your payment mandate's spending cap; preview_checkout does. Read-only on Trusteed's side: where the store prices orders on its own platform (WooCommerce), the store builds a temporary cart to compute the quote and discards it. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

cart_id.description: Cart session ID returned by create_cart

name: quote_checkout

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant at which this checkout SESSION stops being usable. It is not a stock reservation and not a price guarantee.

expires_in_seconds.description: Whole seconds left on this checkout SESSION at response time (0 when already past). It is not a stock reservation and not a price guarantee.
